Setup complete. You are good to go.
Setup complete. The floating overlay can analyze posts now.
Finish setup: grant overlay permission and enable Accessibility service.
Grant overlay permission so the floating button can stay above apps.
Enable Accessibility service so Wais can read visible post text.
Reads visible on-screen post text for fact checking, and captures a screenshot only when you double-tap the Wais button to check an image
No readable text found from current app screen
Not enough text found on this screen. If this is an image or meme, double-tap the Wais button to check the image.

Checking an image takes a screenshot of your current screen and sends it to Google Gemini to read the claim. Anything visible on screen, including private content, will be sent. Nothing is captured unless you double-tap the button or press Check image.
Turn on the Wais accessibility service to check images.
